+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Iterable, List, Sequence
+
+import requests
+
+
+DEFAULT_API_BASE = "https://api.openai.com/v1"
+DEFAULT_MODEL = "text-embedding-3-small"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class EmbeddingsConfig:
+    api_key: str
+    api_base: str = DEFAULT_API_BASE
+    model: str = DEFAULT_MODEL
+    timeout: float = 60.0
+
+
+def load_config() -> EmbeddingsConfig:
+    api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", "").strip()
+    if not api_key:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    api_base = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_BASE", DEFAULT_API_BASE).strip() or DEFAULT_API_BASE
+    model = os.getenv("OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL", DEFAULT_MODEL).strip() or DEFAULT_MODEL
+    timeout = float(os.getenv("OPENAI_TIMEOUT", "60"))
+    return EmbeddingsConfig(api_key=api_key, api_base=api_base.rstrip("/"), model=model, timeout=timeout)
+
+
+class DirectEmbeddingsClient:
+    def __init__(self, config: EmbeddingsConfig | None = None):
+        self.config = config or load_config()
+        self._session = requests.Session()
+        self._session.headers.update(
+            {
+                "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.config.api_key}",
+                "Content-Type": "application/json",
+            }
+        )
+
+    def embed(self, input_text: str) -> List[float]:
+        return self.embed_many([input_text])[0]
+
+    def embed_many(self, inputs: Sequence[str]) -> List[List[float]]:
+        if not inputs:
+            return []
+        response = self._session.post(
+            f"{self.config.api_base}/embeddings",
+            json={"model": self.config.model, "input": list(inputs)},
+            timeout=self.config.timeout,
+        )
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        payload = response.json()
+        data = payload.get("data", [])
+        return [item["embedding"] for item in sorted(data, key=lambda x: x.get("index", 0))]
+
+
+def get_client() -> DirectEmbeddingsClient:
+    return DirectEmbeddingsClient()
+
+
+def embed_text(text: str) -> List[float]:
+    return get_client().embed(text)
+
+
+def embed_texts(texts: Iterable[str]) -> List[List[float]]:
+    return get_client().embed_many(list(texts))
*** End Patch

+import os
+from typing import List, Sequence
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_MODEL = "text-embedding-3-small"
+
+
+def _client() -> OpenAI:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise EnvironmentError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    return OpenAI(api_key=api_key)
+
+
+def embed_query(query: str, model: str = DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_MODEL) -> List[float]:
+    response = _client().embeddings.create(model=model, input=query)
+    return list(response.data[0].embedding)
+
+
+def embed_documents(documents: Sequence[str], model: str = DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_MODEL) -> List[List[float]]:
+    if not documents:
+        return []
+    response = _client().embeddings.create(model=model, input=list(documents))
+    return [list(item.embedding) for item in response.data]
+
+
+def embed_for_search(query: str, documents: Sequence[str], model: str = DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_MODEL):
+    return {
+        "query_embedding": embed_query(query, model=model),
+        "document_embeddings": embed_documents(documents, model=model),
+    }

+import os
+import math
+from typing import List
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL", "text-embedding-3-small")
+
+
+def _embed(client: OpenAI, text: str) -> List[float]:
+    response = client.embeddings.create(model=OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL, input=text)
+    return list(response.data[0].embedding)
+
+
+def cosine_similarity(text_a: str, text_b: str) -> float:
+    client = OpenAI()
+    vec_a = _embed(client, text_a)
+    vec_b = _embed(client, text_b)
+    dot = sum(a * b for a, b in zip(vec_a, vec_b))
+    norm_a = math.sqrt(sum(a * a for a in vec_a))
+    norm_b = math.sqrt(sum(b * b for b in vec_b))
+    if norm_a == 0.0 or norm_b == 0.0:
+        return 0.0
+    return dot / (norm_a * norm_b)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import sys
+
+    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
+        raise SystemExit("Usage: similarity_score.py <text_a> <text_b>")
+    print(cosine_similarity(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]))
*** End Patch

+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from typing import List
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL", "text-embedding-3-small")
+OPENAI_API_KEY = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+OPENAI_API_BASE = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_BASE", "https://api.openai.com/v1")
+
+
+def embed_batch(texts: List[str]) -> List[List[float]]:
+    if not OPENAI_API_KEY:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    response = requests.post(
+        f"{OPENAI_API_BASE.rstrip('/')}/embeddings",
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENAI_API_KEY}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json={"model": OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL, "input": texts},
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    payload = response.json()
+    return [item["embedding"] for item in sorted(payload["data"], key=lambda x: x["index"])]
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    raw = sys.stdin.read().strip()
+    texts = json.loads(raw) if raw else []
+    if not isinstance(texts, list) or not all(isinstance(t, str) for t in texts):
+        raise ValueError("Expected a JSON array of strings on stdin")
+    embeddings = embed_batch(texts)
+    json.dump(embeddings, sys.stdout)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from typing import List
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL", "text-embedding-3-small")
+OPENAI_API_KEY = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+OPENAI_API_BASE = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_BASE", "https://api.openai.com/v1")
+
+
+def embed_batch(texts: List[str]) -> List[List[float]]:
+    if not OPENAI_API_KEY:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    response = requests.post(
+        f"{OPENAI_API_BASE.rstrip('/')}/embeddings",
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENAI_API_KEY}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json={"model": OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL, "input": texts},
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    payload = response.json()
+    return [item["embedding"] for item in sorted(payload["data"], key=lambda x: x["index"])]
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    raw = sys.stdin.read().strip()
+    texts = json.loads(raw) if raw else []
+    if not isinstance(texts, list) or not all(isinstance(t, str) for t in texts):
+        raise ValueError("Expected a JSON array of strings on stdin")
+    embeddings = embed_batch(texts)
+    json.dump(embeddings, sys.stdout)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

import os
from typing import List

from openai import OpenAI


def embed_text(text: str) -> List[float]:
    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
    response = client.embeddings.create(
        model="text-embedding-3-small",
        input=text,
    )
    return response.data[0].embedding
